subject: Greenfield: demo scheduling — align demo with budget gate and CTO travel
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:22 -0700
Subject: Greenfield: demo scheduling — align demo with budget gate and CTO travel

Hi Amanda,

Thanks again for the time today. Quick follow-up to lock in the next steps for the demo and make sure we align with your upcoming budget timing. We had tentatively penciled in a hands-on technical walkthrough the week of Apr 26 — I wanted to check whether that still works given the reforecast discussions you mentioned.

Options that work on our side:
- Wed, Apr 28, 10:00–11:00 PT: full technical walkthrough + Q&A (recommended)
- Wed, May 5, 10:00–11:00 PT: deeper demo if you need to wait for the budget gate to clear
- Short exec sync (20m) this week if the team wants a quick architecture/ROI summary before the reforecast decision

Ben and Marcus are on copy — Ben will coordinate the calendar and Marcus will do the deep-dive. I attached a one-pager and a proposed calendar .ics so your team can pick what fits.

Attachment: [Greenfield-demo-onepager.pdf (PDF, 95KB)]
Attachment: [proposed-schedule.ics (calendar invite stub)]

Could you share what your preference is and whether procurement needs any pre-demo docs?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Engineer\Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Ruiz <amanda@greenfieldhealth.com>

Cc: Tom Jensen <tom.jensen@greenfieldhealth.com>, procure@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 12:30:45 -0400
Subject: Re: Greenfield: demo scheduling — align demo with budget gate and CTO travel

Hi Naomi,

Appreciate the follow-up and the one-pager. Quick update from our side: CTO (Tom) will be traveling Apr 25–29 for a customer visit, and Finance is running a short reforecast that wraps up the week of May 3. That means the technical team will be split next week and we likely won't get a firm budget decision until the May 3–7 window.

We have two asks:
1) Can we do a brief 20-minute exec-level sync on Fri Apr 22 (11:00 PT) so our leadership sees the value and we can align procurement expectations?
2) Move the deep technical walkthrough to the week of May 10 (preferably May 12) — that gives us time to finish the reforecast and have the right stakeholders present.

Procurement looped in — they may want a short SOW/PO template after the exec sync.

Thanks,
Amanda Ruiz
Director of IT Programs\Greenfield Health

- Exec sync: Fri Apr 22, 11:00 PT (20 min) — Naomi + Ben (exec overview), Marcus (availability for Q&A)
- Technical walkthrough (deep-dive): Wed May 12, 10:00–11:30 PT — Marcus to demo integrations and latency/cost profile

Ben — can you send the invite and include Lauren on procurement questions? Lauren — I attached the standard PO checklist and a stub SOW we can tailor for Greenfield.

Attachments: [procurement-checklist.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

Naomi
